call_points.text: Exports were about ₹50 Cr, nearly the whole of last year's export value, led by fibre and power cables to the US and Europe.
Electrical cable margins are about 10.5% and management calls them sustainable.
Germanium tetrachloride supply is hand to mouth; the company has enough for the calendar year with more on the way.
Management declined to quantify data centre order prospects or long-term customer contracts.
Sachin Naik joined as CFO effective 1 June 2026.
Communication cable demand is exceptionally strong driven by data centers and military applications, though raw material constraints exist.
Late-year Middle East disturbances and rupee depreciation increased raw material costs and inventory holdings, putting slight pressure on margins.

operating_notes.text: GST appeal for FY 2020-21 rejected, resulting in a demand of ₹0.12 Cr.
Recorded incremental financial impact of ₹6.01 crores in past service cost due to the implementation of the new Labour Codes.
Copper prices remained volatile throughout the year, complicated by the Middle East conflict.
Preform plant commissioned in mid-March with 100 metric ton capacity, taking 3-4 months to stabilize.
Standard fibre G.652.D settled at USD 12-13 per km in Q1FY27, down from USD 17-18 but above USD 5-6 in December 2025.
Preform capacity of 100 tonnes covers about 4 million km of fibre, half of the planned 8 million km draw capacity.
Electrical cable mix is about 60% construction, with auto, agriculture and industrials at 10-12% each and solar smaller; auto cables were over 14% this quarter.

timeline.summary: Orbit Electricals Private Ltd, via Meena D’Sa, declared no encumbrance on Finolex Cables’ shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.

Finolex Cables Limited, via Sudhir Mandke (General Manager, Legal) & Siddhesh Mandke, sent KYC and nomination reminders to physical shareholders and notified unpaid dividends under SEBI’s March 2023 circular.
Finolex Cables received an order on May 21, 2026, upholding a GST tax demand of ₹0.12 Cr for FY 2020-21.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,951.08 Cr (+22.4% YoY), net profit ₹224.43 Cr (+17.1% YoY).
Finolex Cables published its investor presentation detailing Q4 FY26 performance with revenue of ₹1,951 Cr.
Finolex Cables Limited shared the audio recording of its Analysts/Investors Meet on 29 May 2026 at 4:30 PM (IST) via its website.
Finolex Cables hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 29, 2026, detailing preform plant commissioning and capex plans.
On 13 August 2026 Finolex Cables' Q1FY27 call reported revenue up 44% to ₹2,013 Cr and guided communication cable margins to normalise from near 30% to low double digits.
